question: Who won a bronze medal in Weightlifting at the 2000 Summer Olympics in Sydney?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnam Malleswari**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Karnam Malleswari:-​**

 
 
• She is an Indian weightlifter and is now retired.
 
• She won silver in World Championship, Istanbul in 1994 and Asian Weightlifting Championship, Korea in 1995.
 
• She was the two-time weightlifting champion with 11 Gold medals out of 29 international medals before the Olympics.
 
• In the 2000, Sydney Olympics she won a Bronze medal and become first and only Indian women weightlifter to win Olympics.
 
• She also awarded Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award in 1995, Arjuna Award in 1994 and Padma Shri in 1999.
 
 
 
• **2000 Summer Olympics:-**
 
 
• The 2000 Summer Olympics was an international multi-sport event held from 15 September to 1 October 2000 in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia.
 
• It was the second time the Summer Olympics were held in Australia, and in the Southern Hemisphere.
 
• The United States topped the medal table, followed by Russia and China.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mirabai Chanu:-****​**

 
 
• Saikhom Mirabai Chanu is a weightlifter who hails from Manipur, India.
 
• She competed in the women’s 49-kilogram division at the Olympic Games in Tokyo in 2020 and earned the silver medal.
 
• Because of her hard work and dedication to the sport, the government of India honoured her with the Padma Shri award in 2018.
 
• In 2018, the Government of India honoured her with Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna for her achievements in the athletic world.
 
 
 
• **Neelam Setti Laxmi:-**
 
 
• She is ​s an Indian female weightlifter, competing in the 69 kg category and representing India at international competitions.
 
• She competed at world championships, most recently at the 1999 World Weightlifting Championships.
 
• She also won two silver medals at the 2002 Commonwealth Games.
 
 
 
• Nameirakpam Kunjarani Devi:-
 
 
• She is the most decorated Indian Sportswoman in Weightlifting, in the category of 48kg.
 
• She holds the rank of Commandant in the CRPF and also worked as nodal officer for the sports team in CRPF.
 
• She was also awarded Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna and Arjuna award for the year 2014.
 
• She was also the coach of the Indian Weightlifting in Common Wealth Games 2014 in Glasgow.
